metadata_scope: All filenames and stat sizes only; no WAV header, content hash, or waveform opened before role freeze. README text read.
selection: Pitch order only: sorted 30 main pitches in three blocks of10; zero-based block index3=dev,7=sealed, all others=train. No acoustic features or file sizes used. Same-pitch main/harm layers share role.
auxiliary_policy: Hammer and pedal WAVs remain unopened and auxiliary_unassigned. Conventional rel index+20 MIDI mapping is recorded only as candidate; verify before any use. If confirmed, hammer of held pitch must inherit that pitch role.

rules.train: Only role permitted for initial measurement/fitting; masked training-layer or pitch CV may select future candidates.
rules.dev: Score only after predefined candidate. Never fit. Not opened in initial survey.
rules.sealed: Do not read WAV headers, hash content, decode or listen until explicit owner approval for a selected candidate; metadata names/sizes only.
rules.family: All mic images, resolutions, re-encodings and derived clips of this Princeton session share this pitch split. They are not independent donors.
rules.duplicates: No audio duplicate search performed. If same-strike duplicates or pitch shifts discovered across roles, quarantine the connected group before analysis; do not silently relabel evaluation as training.
